# 联网找资料助手 0.2.4
AI internet capability toolkit derived from Agent-Reach 1.5.0.
Install from the supplied local source or wheel using Python 3.10+; install the skill with `reachkit skill --install`.
Read reachkit/skill/SKILL.md and its task-specific references.
Use capabilities to discover operations; doctor checks local readiness; doctor --upstream probes platform tools; doctor --live verifies public samples.
Commands: read, search, research, collect, tool, install, configure, setup, transcribe, format, doctor, watch, check-update, skill, uninstall.
MCP: optional .[mcp], python -m reachkit.mcp_server. Six tools expose status, capabilities, reading, search, research, collection.
Platform login, browser bridge, configuration and external dependencies must be verified for the selected task.
Upstream source and license: NOTICE, LICENSE. Local modifications: CHANGELOG.md, NOTICE.
